Aerial photos at about 0.3 to 1 m per pi: Hotunan sama na kusan mita 0.3 zuwa 1 a kowane pikisel a yawancin birane, marasa kyau a karkara: suna da kyau sosai don ganin layukan mota, gefen titi da layin dogo. Ranakun ɗaukar hotunan sun bambanta bisa wuri.
Esri World Imagery as an aerial basemap:: Esri World Imagery a matsayin taswirar tushe ta sama: hotunan sama na kusan mita 0.3 zuwa 1 a kowane pikisel a yawancin birane, masu kyau sosai don ganin layukan mota, gefen titi da layin dogo. Ana bayarwa da zarar Mai gudanarwa ya ajiye maɓallin ArcGIS API ya kuma amince da sharuɗɗan Esri a Gudanarwa → Ƙarin manhajoji; tayiloli suna wucewa ta wannan MobSimLab, don haka masu bincike ba sa ganin maɓallin, kuma ba a ajiye su.
